description: This file contains functions for network interface management on Linux, including retrieving and setting IP addresses, netmask, broadcast address, MAC address, MTU, interface status, and managing softwds links. It also includes utility functions for converting addresses and checking interface readiness.

methods.name: os_nif_exists
methods.description: Checks if a network interface with the given name exists by retrieving its index.

methods.name: os_nif_ipaddr_get
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv4 address of the specified interface.

methods.name: os_nif_netmask_get
methods.description: Retrieves the netmask of the specified interface.

methods.name: os_nif_bcast_get
methods.description: Retrieves the broadcast address of the specified interface.

methods.name: os_nif_ipaddr_set
methods.description: Sets the IPv4 address of the specified interface.

methods.name: os_nif_netmask_set
methods.description: Sets the netmask of the specified interface.

methods.name: os_nif_bcast_set
methods.description: Sets the broadcast address of the specified interface.

methods.name: os_nif_mtu_get
methods.description: Retrieves the MTU of the specified interface.

methods.name: os_nif_mtu_set
methods.description: Sets the MTU of the specified interface.

methods.name: os_nif_macaddr
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the specified interface.

methods.name: os_nif_macaddr_get
methods.description: Alias for os_nif_macaddr.

methods.name: os_nif_macaddr_set
methods.description: Sets the MAC address of the specified interface.

methods.name: os_nif_gateway_set
methods.description: Sets the default gateway for the specified interface.

methods.name: os_nif_gateway_del
methods.description: Deletes the default gateway for the specified interface.

methods.name: os_nif_ipaddr_from_str
methods.description: Converts a string IPv4 address to os_ipaddr_t type.

methods.name: os_nif_up
methods.description: Brings the specified interface up or down.

methods.name: os_nif_is_up
methods.description: Checks if the interface is up.

methods.name: os_nif_is_running
methods.description: Checks if the interface is operational (e.g., cable connected).

methods.name: os_nif_softwds_create
methods.description: Creates a softwds link on the interface.

methods.name: os_nif_softwds_destroy
methods.description: Destroys a softwds link.

methods.name: os_nif_list_get
methods.description: Retrieves a list of network interfaces by parsing /proc/net/dev.

methods.name: os_nif_list_free
methods.description: Frees the list of network interfaces.

methods.name: os_nif_is_interface_ready
methods.description: Checks if the interface exists and is operational.
